rubric: This is a podcast / interview transcript. A great clip is ONE complete idea a stranger would stop for: a bold claim or hot take with the reason behind it, a story with its payoff, a surprising fact, or a question and the guest's full answer. It opens on the HOOK (the claim, the question or the first line of the story; never a greeting, a "so, yeah" or the tail of the last answer), is SELF-CONTAINED (no "like I said", no unexplained "he" or "that"), and ends on the PAYOFF line. Reject intros, sponsor and ad reads, housekeeping, plugs, and rambling with no point.
outline: A topic is one question and its whole answer, one story, or one argument. A new topic starts at a new question from the host, a new story, or a clear change of subject; a follow-up question about the same story is the same topic. Ad reads, plugs and intro banter belong to no topic.
review: A podcast clip must carry one complete idea: keep the question when the answer needs it, and end on the line that lands the answer or the story, not on the host's reaction, a laugh line that starts a tangent, or the next question.
